title: Block 1 Revision
source: ICT Grade 3 (Nile International) Block 1 Revision paper (with answers)

scenes.t: An online discussion is sharing ideas on the internet, using a computer.
Netiquette: use kind words, do not shout in capital letters, respect other opinions, and stay safe by not sharing personal information.
An avatar is a picture that represents you in the virtual world. Your digital footprint is the trail of your online activities.
A topic is the subject that starts a discussion. An attachment is a file, an image, a video or a link shared with a post.
Before you leave a public computer, always log out. Never save your password, and never leave your account open.
Two Stars and a Wish: clear pictures and good handwriting are the stars. Use a ruler next time is the wish.
